reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but repeats schedule construction and date-adjustment orchestration.

duplication.why: Schedule construction, conditional occurrence adjustment, and daily holiday eligibility checks are repeated across multiple functions.

placement.why: Holiday mechanics belong in shared/schedules.ts, although the range handler also takes responsibility for adjustment policy and its search margin.

scope.why: The edits remain focused on the requested schedule rules, range endpoint, supporting types, tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: The individual helpers are understandable, but maintaining schedule semantics requires coordinating several construction and adjustment paths.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts independently assembles the recurring schedule already assembled by parseRecurDate in server/rules/rule-utils.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange reshapes getUpcomingDates' occurrence-adjustment pipeline with a different callback variable, an additional frequency condition, and a local solve-mode default.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; recurConfigToRSchedule and both holiday-exclusion helpers introduce daily-specific branches; getDatesInRange independently constructs and orchestrates the schedule.
